initialization: Exact selected interpreter14 trained adapter, SHA256-bound; optimizer reset.
training_loss: Per-example weighted mean of six full-vocabulary class-token cross-entropies. Field weight = 1 + 2 * fraction of alternative gold field labels that change the binary review policy while other gold fields stay fixed.
validation_loss: Unweighted mean of all six full-vocabulary class-token cross-entropies on exactly the same 80 rows as interpreter14/20. Initial loss must reproduce parent within1e-5 before fitting.
selection: Minimum full unweighted validation loss, earlier tie; initial adapter eligible. No calibration selection.
scope: Tests a combined continuation recipe (training curriculum, field weighting, smaller learning rate); does not isolate the causal benefit of field weighting.
queue_status: Prepared; not started or queued yet. Schedule only if remaining work-window time permits full evaluation.
